notes: Source registry for the Border Watch ingestion slice. The list is data, not code: add an outlet here and it is polled on the next sweep. Reliability grades follow the NATO/Admiralty A-F scale and are analyst-editable; every new source starts 'ungraded'.

sources.discoveryNotes: WordPress site; /feed/ honours ETag + Last-Modified (304 on revisit). Article HTML pages return 403 to non-browser clients, the public WP REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts/{id}) does not. robots.txt only disallows search/tag/page/plugin paths for '*'.

No public REST/open-data API beyond the WordPress REST API; main feed is served via FeedPress and honours ETag (304). Item <link> is a FeedPress redirect; the canonical article URL comes from the WP REST 'link' field. AP wire copy carries an apnews.com canonical.

Same Nexstar WordPress stack as Border Report: /feed/ returns 200 (application/rss+xml), public WP REST /wp-json/wp/v2/posts/{id} returns 200. robots.txt for '*' disallows only search/tag/page/plugin paths and lists a news-sitemap. Nexstar corporate Terms of Use (nexstar.tv/terms-of-use) restrict automated data extraction; ingestion is limited to the publisher-advertised feed plus the public REST API, no page scraping of blocked HTML.

WordPress site; /feed/ returns 200 (text/xml, ETag + Last-Modified), guid carries ?p= post id and /wp-json/wp/v2/posts/{id} returns 200. robots.txt for '*' disallows only /search/. No site terms-of-use page was located; treated as feed + public API only.

Blogger Atom feed (application/atom+xml) returns 200 with full post content inline, so the feed body is the text-of-record and article pages are never fetched (Blogger post pages have no <article> container; a page scrape picks up the Popular-posts sidebar). robots.txt for '*' disallows /search and /share-widget, allows /. Blog aggregates and translates Mexican press reports; treat as secondary reporting.

sources.owner: University of San Diego, Justice in Mexico program
sources.discoveryNotes: WordPress site; /feed/ returns 200 (application/rss+xml) and /wp-json/wp/v2/posts/{id} returns 200. robots.txt for '*' disallows only /wp-admin/. Low cadence (a few posts a month).

Mexico tag feed returns 200 (application/rss+xml). robots.txt contains only commented-out rules (nothing disallowed). The main feed is already ingested by the dedicated InSight Crime source; this Border Watch entry keeps only Mexico-tagged items that name a border place so the two do not duplicate each other.

No RSS/Atom endpoint exists (/rss, /feed, /rss7 are 404 or robots-disallowed). robots.txt lists https://www.milenio.com/sitemap/sitemap-google-news-index.xml, whose single child is this Google News sitemap (~700 <url> entries over 48h, each with news:title, news:publication_date and news:keywords). Headline metadata only: articles are not fetched (fetchArticles=false) and only security/state/politics sections naming a border place are kept. Note: cbp/milenio return 403 to curl-based clients but 200 to Node fetch with the same UA.

sources.regionTag: El Paso / Ciudad Juárez (Paso del Norte)
sources.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 (republishing guidelines: attribution, byline, link back, no edits)
sources.discoveryNotes: WordPress site; /feed/ carries teaser + content:encoded, guid is ?p={id} so the public WP REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts/{id}) returns the full text-of-record. robots.txt blocks only named AI crawlers, no rule for '*'. Republishing guidelines (elpasomatters.org/republishing-guidelines) require attribution to El Paso Matters, a link to the original story, and no edits beyond time/style references — CRUCIX shows headline, excerpt and link with outlet attribution.

sources.owner: KJZZ 91.5 (Rio Salado College / Maricopa Community Colleges)
sources.discoveryNotes: fronterasdesk.org redirects to KJZZ. Verified feed is /fronteras-desk.rss (summaries only, no content:encoded; item guid = article URL). Article pages are served to non-browser clients and extract cleanly via the <article> tag; robots.txt has an empty Disallow for '*'. /tags/fronteras.rss is an alternate feed with the same items. Public-media copy: shown with attribution and link, not republished.
